text: Soft chhurpi is pressed, cut and hung over the fire until it is among the hardest cheeses in the world. No durations are given in the sources.

steps.note: The cheese is pressed in a jute bag.
The cheese is hung over a fire, which smoke-dries it.
The cheese is cut into small cuboids.
